description: This is a Java test class for the CapabilitiesDeserializer component in the Nextcloud Notes Android client. It contains unit tests verifying the deserialization of server capabilities JSON responses, including handling of API versions, theming, direct editing support, and feature flags.

classes.name: CapabilitiesDeserializerTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the deserialization of server capabilities JSON responses in the Nextcloud Notes Android client.

methods.name: testDefaultWithoutApiVersion
methods.description: Tests deserialization when the capabilities JSON does not include an api_version field.

methods.name: testDefaultWithApiVersion
methods.description: Tests deserialization when the capabilities JSON includes a valid api_version list.

methods.name: testDefaultWithInvalidApiVersion
methods.description: Tests deserialization when the api_version field is a string instead of a list, expecting fallback behavior.

methods.name: testRealisticSample
methods.description: Tests deserialization of a comprehensive, realistic server capabilities JSON response, including multiple features and nested capabilities.

methods.name: testDirectEditing
methods.description: Verifies detection of direct editing support based on the presence and properties of the directEditing object.

methods.name: testSharingDisabled
methods.description: Checks deserialization when sharing features are disabled or have specific flags set.
